plugins.name: ZCode
plugins.description: Connects BigModel Coding Plan to CPA with ZCode client fingerprint headers, dynamic model discovery, model mapping, and Anthropic-format streaming.
plugins.author: rensumo

plugins.name: Groq Whisper (cpa-groq)
plugins.description: Adds Groq Whisper speech-to-text (whisper-large-v3 and -turbo) as executor models: send audio as Gemini generateContent inline_data, get the transcript back.
plugins.author: batuhan4

plugins.name: ClinePassBridge
plugins.description: 让 Cline Pass 订阅无缝接入 CPA，支持一键获取模型与手动映射，规避原生非流式空响应错误，轻松查看实际命中的上游。 / Seamlessly connect Cline Pass subscriptions to CPA, fetch models in one click or map them manually, avoid native non-streaming empty-response errors, and see the actual upstream provider.
plugins.author: xiao-qiu-qiu

plugins.name: JS Handler
plugins.description: A CLIProxyAPI plugin that executes external JavaScript scripts to intercept and modify requests, responses, and streaming chunks using the Goja VM engine.
plugins.author: easyatm

plugins.name: Censorship
plugins.description: Filters selected text in CLIProxyAPI request bodies with strict format and role scopes, supporting block, strip, and zero-width obfuscation modes. Use it to reject or transform configured terms before upstream execution; it never inspects or changes model responses.
plugins.author: DoingDog
